name: José Luis Rodríguez (El Puma)
scope: Dedicated Puma audit. Real shared-engine fights and production rendering in my own native preview tab. Repository writes limited to this report and tests/character-audits/puma.test.ts; no runtime/art edits, commits or child agents.

identityAndPortrayal.preservedDossier: José Luis Rodríguez González: mature Venezuelan singer with silver swept-back wavy hair, dark expressive eyebrows, prominent straight nose, warm skin and calm theatrical presence. Preserved TVN/NTN24/Telemundo research used; no new external research.
identityAndPortrayal.visualObservation: The production eight-pose atlas retains silver wavy hair, mature face, dark stage jacket, open dark shirt, charcoal trousers and polished shoes. The open-palm invitation and chest lift fit his singer portrayal. Complete silhouettes and coherent mirrored anatomy were visible.
identityAndPortrayal.adaptation: Roar cones, punches and kicks are established fictional arcade adaptations; dossier clothing is preserved as a stage-inspired adaptation.
identityAndPortrayal.audio: Source routing uses generic male jump/attack/hurt effort clips from /audio/arcade. Preserved original-dialogue dossier entries were not used by this audit. Audio playback and acoustic identity were not assessed.

movementAndStance.reproduction: Poliedro; finish 510 intro ticks. Set Puma x540, rival x920. Hold right24 calls (x628.5716689113214, facing+1), then left24 (x547.4280907565621, facing-1). Release10 calls, jump, advance10 (y454.6). Second jump accepted, immediate third rejected. Advance100: grounded=true, y554, jumps0, stocks2.
movementAndStance.stance: Combat ready and block use frame1. All eight actual combat sprites were inspected with production drawSprite at facing+1 and-1. No clipping, borrowed body part or face-direction reversal was observed.

attacksAndCombos.heavy: At gap80, connects once at frame11. Javier HP85.0032 (13*1.12*1.03 damage); facing guard retains HP100. Both sides pass.

attacksAndCombos.upgradedCombo: Crescendo L→L→H with at least1 win: all3 strikes land with approach inputs, HP61.6428, heavy bonus7, 117 simulation ticks. At zero wins the same chain yields Primer rugido and bonus3.
attacksAndCombos.recognition: Separate gap140 whiff probes establish input-chain upgrade gates. Connected-chain checks establish actual strike contact. Input-chain recognition includes whiffs by design.
attacksAndCombos.super: Último aplauso at gap200 starts only with3 wins and75 energy. Frame9 hit: HP55.3392, one hit, damage=(28*1.12+12)*1.03=44.6608. 0/2 wins and3 wins with74 energy reject; both sides pass. Uses current shared close-range super.

special.name: Rugido del Puma
special.distinctBehavior: Single stationary forward cone with strong outward/airborne knockback, no projectile, radial hit, dash or teleport.
special.reproduction: Poliedro at tick510 after intro. Side0: Puma x180, Javier x380; side1: Puma x900, Javier x700. Both energy100, grounded, no invincibility. Increment Puma special once; idle/hold-front-block/hold-block-and-move-away variants. At call1 energy75; through call15 target HP100. Call16/tick526 resolves one contact.
special.idle: Both sides: target HP81.5424, one hit, outward vx±14.461013333333334. Puma stays at origin. No projectiles. Target is airborne. No second hit during recovery.
special.frontGuard: Hold block with no movement: target faces incoming roar, HP100, zero Puma hits, special block effect. Target energy89.08 at contact includes16 held-guard drain ticks and9 block cost.
special.rearGuard: Hold block and right on target for side0, block and left for side1: target faces away, takes same18.4576 damage, one hit, no successful block.
special.range: Both sides at initial gap80/200/259 hit once. Gap260/280 miss (strict less-than260 range). After starting the roar, moving the rival behind the locked facing at distance80 misses on both sides.
special.energyAndRecovery: Energy24 rejects special; energy100 spends25 before hit rewards. By56 total calls the attack and cooldown have ended. Strong knockback at gap200 moves target toward arena edge; no stock is lost in these56-call probes.
special.observedSideTiming: Side0 target updates physics after the same-step contact (vy-7.28); side1 target was updated earlier in the step and shows vy-7.8 until the next active step. This shared sequential-player timing did not create different contact, damage or guard outcomes and is not reported as a Puma-specific defect.

cpuFight.method: Finish intro; Puma idle180 calls to exercise CPU offense; then approach, guard, jump and choose real light/heavy/roar/super inputs. Two entire fights compared with deep equality of final full state.
cpuFight.limitation: Roar started but did not land in this complete bout; dedicated range and directional-guard checks verify its actual contacts. Deterministic controller exercises mechanics; not a balance benchmark.

introAndSelection.name: Invita al público con la mano
introAndSelection.oneShot: selectionProgress clamps to1 at2800ms and remains1 at5600/14000ms. Pose and gesture sampling clamp to their final guard/rest; Portrait stops requesting selection animation at completion. Engine intro blocks actions and movement until shared tick510 on either player side.
introAndSelection.method: Used production loadSprite/drawSprite/drawPresentation and renderMatch inside an ephemeral canvas in my own T3 preview tab. Inspected16 combat views; intro and selection at0/.31/.64/1 in both facings; full cinematic on Puma left at tick52 and right at tick232; actual stepped-engine roar impact at tick526 both sides.
introAndSelection.observation: Start/end display guard1. Midpoints open the palm, invite the audience and subtly lift the chest. Both mirrored full cinematic samples retain head and active hand framing, facing the rival. The roar cone points toward the rival and the impact appears at actual contact on both sides.
introAndSelection.transientLimits: First native loadSprite('puma') rejected with 'No se pudo cargar el asset puma-v3'. Local HTTP fetch confirmed200 image/webp,238646 bytes; reloading my own tab recovered and all sprites loaded. A subsequent shared-dev hot reload reset the ephemeral window harness; reimporting production modules recovered. No server or fallback browser was started.
introAndSelection.limitations: Representative static production-rendered samples inspected, not every interpolation frame. No ordinary UI match selection, audiovisual sync or audio listening tested.

recommendation: Retain current Puma behavior and likeness. No reproducible Puma-specific runtime or sprite defect was found.
